item.text: I found at least three opening styles in the corpus: `From X to Y ... inspected`, `On X ... inspected`, and `During the X-Y field inspection ...`. I’m doing one more pass over a larger sample to make sure the rule keys off the opening inspection sentence and not incidental later mentions.
